contests.title: Bethel town — Article1: Highway garage bonds
contests.scopeNote: Exact existing BethelTown county subdivision; smaller BethelCDP and WindsorCounty are not substituted.

provenance.sourceOrg: Town of Bethel; adopted current warning and ballot form
provenance.quote: Shall general obligation bonds or notes of the Town of Bethel in an amount not to exceed Three Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($3,500,000), subject to reduction by grants-in-aid or other sources, be issued to construct a new Town highway garage (approx.8,800 square feet) at 443 Sand Hill Road?

measures.questionText: Shall general obligation bonds or notes of the Town of Bethel in an amount not to exceed Three Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($3,500,000), subject to reduction by grants-in-aid or other sources, be issued to construct a new Town highway garage (approx.8,800 square feet) at 443 Sand Hill Road?

provenance.sourceOrg: Town of Bethel; adopted current warning and ballot form
provenance.quote: Shall general obligation bonds or notes of the Town of Bethel in an amount not to exceed Three Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($3,500,000), subject to reduction by grants-in-aid or other sources, be issued to construct a new Town highway garage (approx.8,800 square feet) at 443 Sand Hill Road?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize up to $3.5 million in general obligation bonds or notes to build a new town highway garage of about 8,800 square feet at 443 Sand Hill Road. Grants and other available funding would reduce the amount borrowed. The town’s current financing explanation describes a 30-year note at about 4.23% interest and says capital funds and savings may lower the borrowing; these financing estimates are separate from the ballot’s borrowing limit.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the described borrowing of up to $3.5 million for the new town highway garage.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed garage borrowing authorization.
